scope: Partial MR-07: immutable namespace/birth catalog, one-time initial-member admission and parked node startup. Public SDK/actor integration remains IN_PROGRESS.
environment: macOS-26.5.2-arm64-arm-64bit-Mach-O; actual conditional InMemory object-store operations with yielded interleavings and lost-response faults; real local Raft Engines/RawNodes, explicit parked startup; single-voter development roots for runtime cases and three-voter roots for placement/catalog cases; serial ordinary integration targets; isolated checkout target; debug assertions enabled; debuginfo=0
limitations: Partial MR-07 catalog/bootstrap qualification only. The catalog is available through the unstable verification interfaces; SDK class registration, actor-owned command lifecycle/output gating, ordinary-factory mode checks, native/Axum command parity and the counter example remain required. Five planned MR-07 cases are still missing. Normal embedded infrastructure now starts parked, but does not automatically perform catalog reconciliation or SDK routing. The direct trusted RaftRuntime::start path remains available for verification/embedding. Restart currently rereads permanent claims; durable local catalog confirmations and snapshot/join recovery remain recovery-controller work. Live S3/provider behavior, public multi-node command serving, power-loss, production performance and scale are not qualified.

additional_check_results.mode_birth: Conditional namespace roots refuse conflicting mode/schema/cluster/durability/voter policy. Raft data has a disjoint prefix. Concurrent cell creators follow one immutable winning birth. Permanent group-ID reservations reject reuse across cells and namespaces; all catalog mutations use Create, never overwrite fallback.
additional_check_results.claims: Local stable genesis precedes the claim write. An existing remote claim with missing local state refuses blank initialization, including a new directory carrying the old lineage. Competing disk lineages cannot both obtain one member. Exact engine-owner permits fence an earlier process/engine; birth handles cannot cross catalog instances.
additional_check_results.faults: Lost create responses reconcile by reading canonical objects. A failed confirmation read returns no permit even after local genesis and claim write; 30 ticks cannot make a parked group vote or emit messages. Retry uses the same local identity and immutable claim.
additional_check_results.bounds: Canonical marker-1 records enforce domain, length, payload and SHA-256 integrity. Bounded full-object streams reject corrupt or oversized catalog records; no listing is needed for admission.
additional_check_results.regressions: 82 passed: native_log_protocol (7), native_raft_contract (6), native_raft_execution (14), native_raft_ltx (15), native_raft_runtime (14), native_raft_storage (10), native_raft_transport (9), native_replication (6), native_storage (1). Six ignored child helpers are invoked by their parents. The run preceded the final catalog-only global group-ID reservation refinement and Rustdoc-only changes; unaffected runtime/host code was identical, and the full catalog target/Clippy were rerun afterward.
